retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s airbrushed aesthetic featuring a sharp diagonal split between a dark navy foreground and a metallic sunburst sky with interlocking multiline typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition divided diagonally from the lower left to upper right, featuring a dark navy base and a top section of radiating airbrushed rays emanating from a central sun, overlaid with complex interlocking outline lettering and a stylized palm tree.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal horizon line separating dark solid space from light textured sky
Interlocking relationship between display typography and a palm tree graphic
Radiating sunburst lines creating a sense of depth and perspective
Contrast between geometric ray patterns and organic script lettering
coreInvariants: Sharp diagonal division of the canvas
Airbrushed metallic gradients in the sunburst

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary display text is anchored in the upper right quadrant, overlapping the sunburst; secondary script text is centered diagonally in the dark foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central sun and the interlocking 'O' of the display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal horizon from bottom-left to top-right, then circles through the interlocking display type and down to the script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of solid dark navy in the lower half provides high contrast for the script lettering.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark navy and the bright metallic sky; low saturation in the sky with a pop of warm-to-cool saturation in the script.

letterConstructionRules: Display type uses a double-line outline with rounded terminals
Letters in the display type must interlock or overlap significantly
Script type features a consistent upward slant and varying stroke weight
The 'O' in the display type serves as a frame for graphic elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders of lowercase letters are elongated to reach the top edge
The letter 'O' is enlarged to contain a palm tree silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric interlocking outlines paired with a fluid, organic hand-written script for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric skeleton for the interlocking display type.
Captures the casual, slanted energy of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a diagonal split composition. The bottom-left half is solid dark navy. The top-right half features a metallic silver and light blue airbrushed sunburst radiating from a central point. Include a stylized white palm tree silhouette near the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom interlocking double-outline lowercase lettering in the top-right quadrant. Add a slanted, peach-to-lavender gradient script across the dark navy section following the diagonal axis.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon line a sharp diagonal?
Do the display letters interlock and overlap?
Is the sunburst airbrushed with metallic gradients?
Does the script text have a color gradient?

mustAchieve: Clean vector-like outlines for display type
High contrast between navy and silver

postGenerationChecks: Check that the display type is lowercase and double-outlined.
Ensure the palm tree is integrated into the lettering.
Verify the script text follows the diagonal slope.
Confirm the sunburst rays radiate from a single focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Diagonal Split + Airbrush Sunburst + Interlocking Outline Type + Gradient Script
